title: Proteomic Profiling of Biological Tissue Response to Orthodontic Force Application – pilot study
summary: This study investigates how the tissue around the teeth responds to orthodontic forces. For this purpose, saliva and gingival crevicular fluid samples will be analyzed during different treatment approaches, fixed braces and removable aligners. The aim is to detect changes in the proteins contained in these samples and to better understand how teeth move under mechanical load. The results may help to make future treatments more individualized, effective, and gentle.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indication for orthodontic treatment with aligners or multibracket appliances
Complete medical history, as well as clinical and radiographic assessment
Exclusion criteria:
Smoker
Medication use
Systemic diseases (acute or chronic)
Oral pathologies (e.g. active caries, gingivitis, or periodontitis, salivary gland disorders)
